rationale: Source pin is 2.5.3. Airflow 3 ships only the migrations from the 2.6.2 baseline forward; running airflow db migrate from a 3.0 binary against a 2.5.x database has no migration chain. The supported route is a two-stage upgrade: first apply the 2.5 -> 2.10 LTS migrations using a 2.10 binary, then move to 3.0 using the 3.0 binary.
